name: PlaceKitten
tagline: Simple kitten placeholder images by width and height for UI mockups
description: PlaceKitten serves randomly selected kitten photos sized to any width and height you request via a straightforward URL pattern. Developers use it as a drop-in image placeholder in HTML, CSS, and design prototypes without authentication or signup. Optional grayscale variants and size parameters make it a classic fun utility for mockups and demos.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public HTTP GET by width/height path segments.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unlimited free public use; no published quotas

use_cases: placeholder kitten image for UI mockup by width and height
grayscale kitten placeholder for design prototypes
drop-in image URL for HTML/CSS demos without assets
